question: Does the reviewed EFMW corpus entail a mass-coupling law or a quantitative observable relationship beyond generic scalar effective field theory?
status: exploratory mathematical audit; no new physical data
freeze_timing: Source screening and candidate algebra preceded this lock. This freezes source snapshots, assumptions, verification targets and criteria before executing the new checks; it is not an independent preregistration.
branch: C1 classical, flat background, source-free vacuum near scalar origin; separate canonical ME-002 propagation branch is not identified with C1.

criteria.source_entailment: Every restriction must follow from the frozen action and explicitly listed branch assumptions; newly chosen restrictions are not source evidence.
criteria.novelty: Compare C1 predictions with the same canonically normalized scalar-photon action in established literature, including arbitrary masses and couplings.
criteria.verification: Exact symbolic identities must simplify to zero; explicit counterexamples must satisfy their stated local branch assumptions; numerical spectral comparisons use rtol 1e-11 and atol 1e-13.
criteria.empirical: No numerical or symbolic result is classified as a measurement or a confirmation of EFMW.

operations.name: Parameter non-entailment
operations.transformation: Construct nonzero couplings at fixed mass and independent masses at fixed coupling within a common positive local kinetic domain.
operations.pass: Two admissible different couplings at one mass disprove any universal single-valued g=f(m) from these assumptions.

operations.name: Classical low-energy matching
operations.input: C1 positive definite scalar mass Hessian A and photon couplings b, X=F^2
operations.transformation: Eliminate scalar fields to order X^2; independently diagonalize A and compare spectral sum; derive weak-field refractive response.
operations.pass: a_X=1/2 b^T A^-1 b=sum g_i^2/(32 m_i^2), Delta n=16 a_X B^2 to leading order, with nonnegative omitted-mode terms.

operations.name: Cross-channel rank stress test
operations.input: Two gauge invariants and C1 allowed direct XY coupling
operations.transformation: Compute response determinant and supply one-scalar contact and two-scalar counterexamples.
operations.pass: Identify exactly when rank-one identity holds and exhibit allowed C1 branches violating it.

operations.name: Kinetic-domain test
operations.transformation: Solve positivity for all real sigma versus a bounded interval.
operations.pass: All-real positivity forces g=0; bounded positivity only bounds magnitude.

operations.name: Normalization and propagation separation
operations.input: C1 root Z family; canonical ME-002/004/005
operations.transformation: Vary root action for arbitrary Z; substitute plane wave into the canonical equation without importing alpha_EM.
operations.pass: Verify normalization ambiguity and conditional dispersion; do not conflate branches.

not_run: Exhaustive search of every EFMW repository

literature.role: Prior scalar-photon action; equivalent after signature and sign conventions.
